description: Smelt items end-to-end: open the furnace at furnacePos (or use the already-open furnace), load fuel + input, then poll until `count` outputs have been produced, fuel runs out, or the input is exhausted, collecting outputs as they appear. Cancellable. Approach: drives off the furnace `update` event with a per-wait tick timeout, re-checking progress/slots each cycle.

furnacePos.description: Furnace block position; omit to use the already-open furnace

name: smelt_item
